control_phase_a_audit: 19 wins, 1 chop, 0 losses; retained unchanged at reports/v05/final
axis: Only preflop facing-raise minimum feature score against confirmed aggression; all profile, postflop, trap and opening rules held fixed. No changes from final card outcomes.
selection: Screen on new development seeds. Rank by minimum per-match CI lower bound; ties by mean paired BB. Confirm best candidate via full HTTP against control on train and confirmation seeds. Promote only if all 16 candidate HTTP matches win, candidate gains >=0.25 mean paired BB/deal overall, improves AlwaysPot mean by >=0.5 BB/deal, no opponent loses >=1 match point or >=0.5 mean BB/deal. If none qualify retain phase A. Both candidates already at match-point ceiling can improve confidence/BB instead of impossible +0.5 points.
final_policy: Never reuse phase A final seeds. New five final labels are sealed until a new source/config freeze.

screen_selection.rule: Highest minimum per-match CI lower bound on new development screen, as preregistered. Confirm this one candidate against fixed score-30 control through full HTTP train and confirmation sets. No new final seeds accessed.
